definitions.plant_z: Z = ln(N)/ln(P_max(N)) on the PLANTED positions only
definitions.null_t_deep: STAT-TAIL-DEEP of the SAME replicate's unplanted uniform base: its TENTH LARGEST Z
definitions.deep_tail: the top 10 Z values of a replicate
definitions.insertion: a PLANTED position that appears in the planted replicate's deep tail
definitions.eviction: a member of the null deep tail that is not still a surviving unplanted member of the planted deep tail, whether it was overwritten by a plant or pushed out
definitions.survivor: a null deep-tail position that is unplanted and still in the planted deep tail
definitions.promoted: a deep-tail slot filled by an unplanted sample that was not in the null deep tail
definitions.exceedance: a planted Z strictly greater than THAT REPLICATE'S OWN null tenth-largest Z
